_why_in_set: Ground truth for the single most dangerous failure mode of the computed-tractability axis: geometric pocket scoring is blind to cryptic pockets. Every number here was produced by running fpocket 4.2.3 on downloaded RCSB structures in this repo, not retrieved from literature.

_method.clustering_note: At the fpocket default -D 2.4 the nucleotide site and switch-II site MERGE into one 1540 A^3 mega-pocket (druggability 0.886) because they are contiguous through residues 12/16/34 once ligands are stripped. -D 1.6 resolves them FOR KRAS.
_method.VOID_do_not_pin: An earlier version of this file said 'Pin this parameter.' That instruction is VOID. -D 1.6 is KRAS-specific tuning and does NOT generalise: on TNF-alpha it returns druggability 0.002 at the site of a co-crystallised 570 Da ligand, a false negative on a holo structure. Sweep D over at least {1.6, 2.4} and report the range. See the TNF-alpha calibration.
_method.prep: chain A, protein only, altloc A, hydrogens stripped

target.annotation_source: UniProt P01116 key_features, retrieved via paperclip /proteins/P01116/content.lines L5

structures.description: human KRAS G12C covalently bound to AMG 510 (sotorasib)
ligands: MOV (sotorasib, 41 heavy atoms, covalent to Cys12)

structures.description: GDP-bound human KRAS, no drug-like ligand
structures.apo_caveat: nucleotide-bound, not truly ligand-free; correct control for the switch-II question specifically

THE_FINDING.claim: Geometric pocket scoring finds the sotorasib site only when the drug is already bound. On apo it is scored as noise.

physical_collapse_evidence.superposition: 4OBE onto 6OIM on 128 core CA excluding both switch regions, RMSD 0.86 A
physical_collapse_evidence.sotorasib_clashes_in_apo_frame: 6 heavy atoms within 2.0 A, 20 within 3.0 A (residues 16,59,60,61,68,71,72,95,99)
physical_collapse_evidence.self_control_baseline: same test against 6OIM itself: 1 atom within 2.0 A (the Cys12 covalent bond), 2 within 3.0 A
physical_collapse_evidence.interpretation: the clash is a real apo conformational difference, not superposition error

THE_FINDING.control_site_is_stable: The nucleotide site scores comparably in both (0.020 holo / 0.442 apo; the holo value is depressed only because ligand removal merges it with the opened switch-II site). So the method is reliable for pre-formed pockets.
THE_FINDING.consequence_for_the_agent: When only apo structures exist, a low pocket score is an ABSENCE OF MEASUREMENT, not evidence against tractability. Set cryptic_pocket_risk=high whenever structure.tier is apo or predicted.
THE_FINDING.consequence_for_the_retrospective_eval: Every KRAS structure before ~2013 was apo or GDP-bound. Our method run honestly in 2012 would have returned 'not tractable', reproducing the field's 30-year error. The agent must therefore NOT claim it would have found G12C early. The demonstrable claim is that it knows when it cannot see.
THE_FINDING.what_would_be_needed_to_see_cryptic_site: conformational sampling in front of the pocket call: MD, mixed-solvent MD, or ensemble docking. A single-structure pocket call cannot do it.

REPRODUCED_THROUGH_THE_PIPELINE_2026_08_.why_this_entry_exists: The 650x claim originally came from a bespoke analysis script, NOT from the deployed system. Until same-site tracking existed, the production pipeline could not reproduce it — on an apo structure it fell back to 'most druggable pocket anywhere', which pools different pockets and measures nothing. A first attempt at re-measuring gave 7.8x precisely because of that fallback.
REPRODUCED_THROUGH_THE_PIPELINE_2026_08_.what_was_added: site_signature tracking. A holo structure anywhere in the ensemble donates its ligand-site residues as a signature; apo structures are then scored at the pocket with the highest residue-number overlap, matched chain-agnostically because the site is often inter-subunit and chain letters are not stable across depositions.

kras_result.reading: the switch-II site is now correctly tracked into the apo structure and scores ZERO there. The original calibration, reproduced by the deployed pipeline for the first time.

tnf_result.reading: 651x reproduced end-to-end on the deployed system.

OPEN_CAVEAT_the_matching_is_weak.problem: The 2AZ5 signature is 19 residues. An overlap of 0.071-0.214 means the matched pocket shares only 2-4 of them. That is thin evidence that it is the SAME site rather than a neighbouring pocket that happens to touch a couple of the same residues.
OPEN_CAVEAT_the_matching_is_weak.consequence: The 651x number reproduces, but the claim it supports is only as strong as the matching. Do not publish the figure without stating the overlap.
OPEN_CAVEAT_the_matching_is_weak.what_would_fix_it: A minimum-overlap threshold below which the match is reported as failed rather than accepted, and mdpocket over the ensemble — which computes pocket DENSITY over aligned frames instead of matching independently-detected pockets after the fact. mdpocket ships with fpocket and is already installed.
OPEN_CAVEAT_the_matching_is_weak.status: OPEN. The volume spread (84.1%) is subject to the same caveat.

also_observed.note: the known -D 1.6 false negative on a co-crystallised holo site, reproduced again. At D=2.4 the same site is rank 5 with druggability 0.587. Further evidence for sweeping D rather than pinning it.
